title: Power the Rack
lesson: Active gear is dark until PSU cords land on a PDU. Keep power and data on opposite mental paths — same habit as real racks (TIA-942 / BICSI).
brief: Facility power was pulled. ToR-SW-A and SERVER-01 are dark, and the copper data path is down with them. Restore power first, then bring the documented data path back online.
constraints: Power and data are separate paths — restore both
Use the PDU outlets and C13 cords already staged for this rack
Do not leave the service on an undocumented copper path
